parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, normal PR and axis, and normal R-wave progression with no pathological Q waves. The mild concave ST elevation with tall upright T waves in V2-V4 looks like benign early repolarization (a normal variant), not an anterior MI, and it does not meet STEMI criteria.
